# Institute Post-Doctoral Fellows (IPDF)

An Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow works in your group but draws the
fellowship from the Institute, so you do not need a project to pay
for one. The Dean (Faculty Affairs) runs IPDF hiring. In your academic
unit, the Department Post-doctoral Committee (or the FSC/DPC) screens
the applications.

## Eligibility

- The candidate should have a fresh PhD, a PhD with less than two
  years of experience, or a submitted thesis awaiting examination.
- The candidate should preferably be under 32. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwD
  candidates get age relaxation under Government of India norms.
- IIT Bombay's own PhD students cannot apply.
- You can mentor at most two external IPDFs at a time.
- The call has no last date, so candidates can apply at any time.

## Fellowship

- ₹ 80,000 a month (consolidated), plus HRA at the Government of India
  rate, currently 30% of the consolidated salary.
- A non-lapsable contingency grant of ₹ 1,00,000 a year.
- 30 days of earned leave a year, casual leave, and OPD medical
  treatment.
- Support for one international conference during the fellowship,
  usually after the first year, to present work done at IIT Bombay,
  and for one national conference each year.

The Institute does not give IPDFs campus housing and pays HRA instead.
A new fellow can stay in the Guest House at the going rate while
looking for a flat.

## Selection procedure

The candidate first asks you to be the mentor. With your consent, they
send the [IPDF application
form](https://www.iitb.ac.in/sites/default/files/Application%20Form%20-%20for%20IPDF.doc)
to the Head of your academic unit. Since April 2025 every academic
unit follows the same seven steps:

1. The candidate submits the application with your consent email
   attached.
2. The PDF Screening Committee, FSC or DPC either rejects the
   application or invites the candidate to give a seminar.
3. The candidate gives the seminar, online or in person. Circulate the
   notice widely.
4. At least three or four faculty members from the area fill in a
   standard feedback form on the seminar.
5. The candidate sends two or three referee letters. You add your own
   detailed letter comparing the candidate with PhD students you have
   graduated.
6. The DPC meets in person, reviews the feedback and letters, and
   decides whether to recommend the candidate. It cannot decide by
   email or circulation.
7. The Head presents the case to the Institute Standing Committee for
   External PDF appointments, with a summary sheet of the unit's
   applicants. The Standing Committee approves or rejects it.

For each candidate your unit fills in two forms ([templates on
bighome](https://bighome.iitb.ac.in/index.php/s/94nkwAYee8qqAMB)). The
Post-doctoral Candidate Evaluation Form rates the seminar, the
research and publications, and the candidate's teaching and research
potential, and ends with an overall recommendation. The Summary Sheet
by Department records the candidate's age against the 32-year cut-off,
category, publications, thesis submission or graduation date, and how
many external IPDFs you already mentor. The Dean (FA) office emails
Heads before each Standing Committee meeting with the date and the
deadline for uploading these forms.

## Joining

The fellow accepts the offer by email and agrees a joining date with
you and the Head. They must join in person. On joining, they take the
joining form to the Faculty and Staff Section (F&SS) with their
certificates, bank details, PAN and Aadhaar. Security issues the ID
card, the department sysadmin sets up the LDAP account, and ASC gives
the ERP licence. To claim HRA, the fellow files the HRA form and rent
agreement with F&SS.

Before leaving, the fellow completes the no-dues (NDC) process. F&SS
holds back the last month's salary until they do.

## Duties

The fellow does research with you. The Head may also give them
reasonable academic or administrative work.

## Tenure and extension

The first appointment is usually for one year. The Institute can
extend it by up to two more years if the fellow's work is
satisfactory.

For an extension after the first year, the fellow writes a progress
report and gives it to you and the Head. The Head forwards it to the
Dean (FA), and F&SS issues the extension order once the Dean
approves.

In 2024 and 2025 a committee set up by the Dean (FA) reviewed the IPDF
programme. It asked faculty about placements, publications, the
fellows' contribution to their units, TA training and innovation.

## ANRF National Post-Doctoral Fellowship (NPDF)

A candidate applying for an NPDF needs an endorsement from the
Institute. Send the Dean (FA) office the DPC minutes recommending the
candidate, and an endorsement letter that you sign as mentor. The
office returns an endorsement signed by the Registrar, which the
candidate uploads to the NPDF portal. If the candidate is already an
IPDF, skip the DPC minutes and route the request through yourself and
the Head.

*Source:* [IIT Bombay, Institute Post-Doctoral Fellowship
(IPDF)](https://www.iitb.ac.in/career/apply/postdoc).
